name: @forguncy-react-workspace/cell-project
//: The consumer entrypoint (#99): one ordinary business project in, and the three verbs #97
names — build, read-only plan, explicit sync — out, without the caller assembling a port,
a decision list, a target or a workspace graph by hand.
This package owns *composition*, not rules. The build is `cell-compiler`'s #97 entry, the
lock projection is `dev-harness`'s local projection (#23, the same one `vp dev` runs), and
the sync is `mcp-sync`'s executor (#19/#20/#93). Nothing here re-derives a decision, a
freshness rule, a mapping table or a mutation payload.
`./cli` is the executable face of the same three functions. A `.ts` bin is deliberate: every
package in this repository ships source rather than a build, and Node 24+ strips the type
annotations itself (the repository `engines` floor is Node 24). The CLI runs from a project's
own tree, so imports of the workspace packages above resolve through the project's installed
links rather than through a second copy.
There is deliberately no built-in MCP client. An authorized designer connection is the
caller's — the Agent's MCP session or a project-owned adapter — and `--port <module>` is how
a process hands one in. Shipping a client here would be a second transport next to the one
